vaccination.description.0.en: The purpose of this Vaccination Questionnaire is to find out more about the immune-protection established through the vaccine and monitor the vaccination uptake in Switzerland.

vaccination.Q0.title.0.en: Four weeks ago you received a questionnaire about your vaccination status. This new questionnaire is to monitor any further changes. Please check the option that applies to you.

vaccination.Q0.rg.scg.option.0.en: In the meantime I received a new vaccine dose or a new invitation to get vaccinated.

vaccination.Q0.rg.scg.option.1.en: In the meantime nothing has changed in regards to my vaccination-status.

vaccination.Q0.rg.scg.option.2.en: I'm not sure and would like to answer the following questions to make sure the information about my vaccination-status is up to date.

vaccination.HV.Q9.title.0.en: Did you receive a flu vaccine (Influenza) during the previous flu (Influenza) season (2022-2023)?

vaccination.HV.Q9.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to understand what level of protection the vaccine provides. Additionally we want to understand, whether there is any longterm protection from vaccines received in previous years.

vaccination.HV.Q9.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

vaccination.HV.Q9.helpGroup.text.3.en: Answer "yes" if you were vaccinated in autumn/winter (2022-2023).

vaccination.HV.Q10.title.0.en: Have you received a flu vaccine (influenza) this autumn/winter (2024-2025)?

vaccination.HV.Q10.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to investigate how much immune-protection the vaccine provides.

vaccination.HV.Q10.helpGroup.text.3.en: Select "yes", if you got vaccinated this season (usually in autumn). If you'll get vaccinated after completing this survey please return to this questionnaire and update your answer.

vaccination.HV.Q10b.title.0.en: When were you vaccinated against flu (inlfuenza) this season (2024-2025)?

vaccination.HV.Q10b.helpGroup.text.1.en: Knowing when people get vaccinated tells us how the vaccination program is being followed and provides us with information about the effectiveness of the vaccine.

vaccination.HV.Q10b.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

vaccination.HV.Q10b.helpGroup.text.3.en: Try to answer as precisely as possible. If you do not know the exact date, provide an estimate as close as possible. For example, if you remember the month, try to recall if it was in the beginning or end of the month. Did any important events take place (such as holidays or birthdays) that may help you to refresh your memory?

vaccination.HV.Q10c.title.0.en: What were your reasons to get vaccinated against the seasonal flue (influenza) this year?

vaccination.HV.Q10c.rg.LlBq.text.0.en: Select the options that are most applicable

vaccination.HV.Q10c.rg.mcg.option.0.en: I belong to a risk group (e.g, pregnant, over 65, underlying health condition, etc.)

vaccination.HV.Q10c.rg.mcg.option.1.en: Vaccination decreases my risk of getting influenza

vaccination.HV.Q10c.rg.mcg.option.2.en: Vaccination decreases the risk of spreading influenza to others

vaccination.HV.Q10c.rg.mcg.option.4.en: It was recommended at my workplace/school

vaccination.HV.Q10c.rg.mcg.option.5.en: The vaccine was readily available and the vaccine administration was convenient

vaccination.HV.Q10c.rg.mcg.option.7.en: I don't want to miss work/school

vaccination.HV.Q10c.rg.mcg.option.9.en: I try to protect myself against infections because of the ongoing Covid-19 pandemic

vaccination.HV.Q10d.title.0.en: What were your reasons for NOT getting the seasonal influenza vaccination this season (2024-2025)?

vaccination.HV.Q10d.helpGroup.text.1.en: We would like to know why some people get vaccinated and others do not.

vaccination.HV.Q10d.helpGroup.text.3.en: Select all the reasons that influenced your decision.

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.t2y2.text.0.en: Select the options that are most applicable

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.mcg.option.0.en: I am planning to be vaccinated, but haven't been yet

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.mcg.option.1.en: I haven't been offered the vaccine

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.mcg.option.2.en: I don't belong to a risk group

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.mcg.option.3.en: I think it is better for the body to build it's own natural immunity against the flu (Influenza)

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.mcg.option.4.en: I doubt that the Influenza vaccine is effective

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.mcg.option.5.en: The flu (Influenza) is a minor illness

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.mcg.option.6.en: I don't think I am likely to get influenza

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.mcg.option.7.en: I believe that the influenza vaccine can cause Influenza

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.mcg.option.8.en: I am worried that the vaccine is not safe or will cause illness/other adverse events

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.mcg.option.10.en: The vaccine is not readily available to me

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.mcg.option.11.en: The vaccine is not free of charge

vaccination.HV.Q10d.rg.mcg.option.13.en: Although my doctor recommended the vaccine, I did not get one

vaccination.HV.Q35.title.0.en: Have you received a Covid-19 vaccine?

vaccination.HV.Q35.helpGroup.text.1.en: We would like to investigate how much protection the vaccines provide.

vaccination.HV.Q35.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

vaccination.HV.Q35.helpGroup.text.3.en: Check yes, if you have received at least one dose of the Covid-19 vaccine (since December 2020).

vaccination.HV.Q35.rg.scg.option.0.en: Yes, I have received at least one Covid-19 vaccine

vaccination.HV.Q35.rg.scg.option.1.en: No, so far I did not receive the Covid-19 vaccine

vaccination.HV.Q35i.title.0.en: Which Covid-19 vaccine(s) (of which producer) did you receive?

vaccination.HV.Q35i.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to know how many people got vaccinated with which vaccine (of which producer)

vaccination.HV.Q35i.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

vaccination.HV.Q35i.helpGroup.text.3.en: Specify with which vaccine of which producer (or vaccines if you had different ones) you got vaccinated

vaccination.HV.Q35i.rg.LMsj.text.0.en: Select more than one option if you have received different vaccines of different producers

vaccination.HV.Q35c.title.0.en: How many doses of the vaccine did you receive?

vaccination.HV.Q35c.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to understand how much protection a complete vaccination cylce provides.

vaccination.HV.Q35c.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

vaccination.HV.Q35c.helpGroup.text.3.en: Report the number of doses you have received so far (which corresponds to the number of times you were vaccinated against Covid-19 ).

vaccination.HV.Q35j.title.0.en: When did you receive your last dose of a vaccine against Covid-19? If you do not know the exact date please provide an estimate.

vaccination.HV.Q35j.helpGroup.text.1.en: Knowing when people are getting vaccinated provides us with information about how well the vaccination program is being carried out.

vaccination.HV.Q35j.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

vaccination.HV.Q35j.helpGroup.text.3.en: Please try and answer as precise as possible. If you do not know the exact date, please provide an estimate (month & year) of the vaccination.

vaccination.HV.Q35k.title.0.en: Do you plan to receive a second dose in the upcoming weeks?

vaccination.HV.Q35k.helpGroup.text.1.en: We want to investigate how long it takes for people to get the second dose after having received the first one

vaccination.HV.Q35k.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

vaccination.HV.Q35k.helpGroup.text.3.en: Select the option that describes your situation the most accurate

vaccination.HV.Q35l.title.0.en: Why have you only received one single dose so far?

vaccination.HV.Q35l.helpGroup.text.1.en: We would like to understand the reasons for only getting one dose

vaccination.HV.Q35l.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

vaccination.HV.Q35l.helpGroup.text.3.en: Select the option that best describes your situation

vaccination.HV.Q35l.rg.scg.option.0.en: I had a Covid-19 infection already before my first dose.

vaccination.HV.Q35l.rg.scg.option.1.en: I had a Covid-19 infection shortly after my first dose, and have to wait several months to be able to get the second dose.

vaccination.HV.Q35l.rg.scg.option.2.en: I received Janssen vaccine, which requires only one dose.

vaccination.HV.Q35l.rg.scg.option.3.en: A second injection was contraindicated for me by a doctor (I had a severe allergic reaction/a severe adverse effect after the first dose, or I have a temporary contraindication due to a treatment or a disease).

vaccination.HV.Q35l.rg.scg.option.4.en: I changed my mind and don’t want to be vaccinated anymore.

vaccination.HV.Q35f.title.0.en: What are your reason(s) for getting vaccinated against Covid-19?

vaccination.HV.Q35f.helpGroup.text.1.en: We would like to understand the main reasons why people get vaccinated.

vaccination.HV.Q35f.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

vaccination.HV.Q35f.helpGroup.text.3.en: Please select the options that have influenced your decision the most.

vaccination.HV.Q35f.rg.T5UL.text.0.en: Select the options that are most applicable

vaccination.HV.Q35f.rg.mcg.option.0.en: The vaccination is recommended by public health authorities.

vaccination.HV.Q35f.rg.mcg.option.1.en: I belong to a group who is at risk of complications in case of Covid-19 (over 65 of age, underlying health condition, obesity, etc.).

vaccination.HV.Q35f.rg.mcg.option.2.en: I work in close contact with people at risk of complications in case of Covid-19 (working in a nursing home, health staff, etc.…).

vaccination.HV.Q35f.rg.mcg.option.3.en: Vaccination decreases my risk of getting Covid-19.

vaccination.HV.Q35f.rg.mcg.option.4.en: Vaccination decreases the risk of spreading Covid-19 to others.

vaccination.HV.Q35f.rg.mcg.option.6.en: It was recommended at my workplace/school.

vaccination.HV.Q35f.rg.mcg.option.7.en: The vaccine was readily available and the vaccine administration was convenient.

vaccination.HV.Q35f.rg.mcg.option.9.en: I don’t want to miss work/school.

vaccination.HV.Q35f.rg.mcg.option.10.en: I always get vaccinated when possible.

vaccination.HV.Q35f.rg.mcg.option.11.en: I have to be vaccinated to work.

vaccination.HV.Q35f.rg.mcg.option.12.en: To obtain a valid vaccination passport (Covid-19 Certificate).

vaccination.HV.Q35m.title.0.en: What are your reasons for NOT getting vaccinated against Covid-19? Select the options that are most applicable.

vaccination.HV.Q35m.helpGroup.text.1.en: We would like understand the main reasons why people choose not to get vaccinated against Covid-19.

vaccination.HV.Q35m.helpGroup.text.2.en: How should I answer this question?

vaccination.HV.Q35m.helpGroup.text.3.en: Please select the options that influenced your decision.

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.nm76.text.0.en: Select the options that are most applicable

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.0.en: I am planning to get vaccinated but I haven’t gotten around to do it yet

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.1.en: I haven't been offered the vaccine

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.2.en: I have been discouraged from being vaccinated because I am pregnant

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.3.en: I am pregnant and I fear the vaccine could be dangerous for my baby

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.4.en: I don’t belong to a risk group

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.5.en: It is better to build up your body's own natural immunity against Covid-19

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.6.en: I doubt that the Covid-19 vaccine is effective

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.8.en: Because of the Covid-19 pandemic, I avoid seeking medical help or going to the pharmacy

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.9.en: I don't think I am likely to get Covid-19

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.10.en: I believe that the Covid-19 vaccine can cause Covid-19

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.11.en: I am worried that the vaccine is not safe/will cause illness or other adverse events

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.13.en: The vaccine is not readily available to me

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.14.en: I disagree with the current vaccine policy

vaccination.HV.Q35m.rg.mcg.option.15.en: The vaccine is not free of charge

vaccination.surveyEnd.title.0.en: Thank you for completing the questionnaire. Please submit it. Thank you for your support.
